code:
# frozen_string_literal: true

require "securerandom"

# Rack middleware that ensures every response has an X-Request-Id header.
#
#   use RequestId
#
# If the incoming request already carries an X-Request-Id (e.g. from an
# upstream proxy or load balancer), it is reused. Otherwise a UUID is
# generated. The id is passed to the downstream app in
# env["HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID"] so it can be included in logs.
class RequestId
  ENV_KEY = "HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID"
  HEADER = "X-Request-Id"

  def initialize(app)
    @app = app
  end

  def call(env)
    request_id = env[ENV_KEY]
    request_id = SecureRandom.uuid if request_id.nil? || request_id.empty?
    env[ENV_KEY] = request_id

    status, headers, body = @app.call(env)

    # Dup so we don't mutate a frozen/shared headers hash.
    headers = headers.dup
    headers[HEADER] = request_id

    [status, headers, body]
  end
end

- Reuses an incoming `X-Request-Id` or generates a UUID via `SecureRandom`
- Exposes the id to downstream apps via `env["HTTP_X_REQUEST_ID"]`
- Dups response headers before adding `X-Request-Id`, so frozen/shared hashes aren't mutated
